environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'doc-services' with default service account. Pod runs as root (UID 0) with no securityContext restrictions. The gRPC server is exposed directly via a Kubernetes Service of type ClusterIP, accessible from other pods in the cluster. No API gateway or ingress controller sits in front of the gRPC service. Other pods in the same namespace (e.g., internal microservices) can call the gRPC endpoint directly on port 50051. The container filesystem includes /etc/shadow, /proc/self/environ, and Kubernetes service account tokens at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token.
